page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.large is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by an AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at 2.55 GHz under the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 virtual CPUs mapped to 1 physical core with 2 threads per core, 4.0 GB of memory (2.0 GB per vCPU), and an L3 cache of 32 MB alongside 32 KB L1d and 0.5 MB L2 caches. The instance has no local storage attached and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates a clear performance split between single-core efficiency and multi-core scalability. It achieves strong performance in stress-ng single-core execution alongside average results in single-threaded gzip compression, single-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Geekbench text processing. Conversely, memory bandwidth testing reveals weak uncached read and write throughput, and multi-core workloads rank in the bottom 25 percent or lower across stress-ng, Geekbench, and PassMark tests due to its single physical core constraint.

Given its 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU allocation and strong single-thread execution speed, the instance offers an entry-level compute footprint. It is suitable for light web serving, basic script execution, small microservices, and single-threaded background tasks where low single-core execution latency is prioritized over heavy multi-core throughput.
